description: Main entry point for a Flutter travel guide application. Defines the root widget and manages navigation between different screens (Explore, Plan, Recommendations, Reviews) via a bottom navigation bar.

classes.name: TravelGuideApp
classes.description: The root widget of the application which sets up the MaterialApp, theme, and initial route.

classes.name: _HomeShell
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that manages the bottom navigation and screen switching.

classes.name: _HomeShellState
classes.description: State class for _HomeShell, manages current index and screen list.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main function that runs the Flutter app, initiating the TravelGuideApp widget.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for TravelGuideApp.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for _HomeShell widget.

methods.name: _onTabSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation tab selection, updating the current index.
